verdict.rationale: Recruitee lists 'Reporting & Insights' as a feature, but the evidence gives no detail on building custom reports. Data can still be pulled out with workarounds: an authenticated API returns the company's candidates, departments with offers counts, and other records, and webhooks push event notifications to your own endpoint. That makes a DIY pipeline to a warehouse possible, but nothing here is a dedicated reporting or export path. Missing for 10: documented custom report builder, scheduled exports, native BI/warehouse connectors, dedicated reporting/analytics API endpoints, published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s), independent corroboration.
